title: CoolClient
description: BlockOutline, Custom Hitbox, Hit Damage Color, Custom Crosshair & PvP Utilities
body:
Take full control of your PvP experience with this feature-packed Minecraft client. Customize your visual feedback with BlockOutline, fine-tune Hitbox precision, personalize Hit Damage Colors, and craft the perfect Crosshair — plus a suite of utilities to enhance your gameplay.
